segments.text: Track 3.1
My name is Kiko and on today's our live show
I want to find out about the lifestyle of teenagers
Excuse me? Can I ask you a few questions about your lifestyle?
Sure, no problem
Thank you. What's your name?
Mehmet
Do you play computer games Mehmet?
Yes I do. I play for one hour in the evening
and about five hours at weekends
And do you watch TV in the evening?
No, I don't watch TV
but I watch films on my computer
And when do you study?
I do my homework in the evening after school
And do you exercise?
Yes, I love football
I play for two hours on Wednesday evenings
Well, thank you Mehmet
Excuse me? Do you have a minute?
No, sorry, I'm busy
Okay, thanks
Excuse me? Can I ask you a few questions?
Sure, thank you
What's your name? Isabella
I want to ask you some questions about your lifestyle
Do you play computer games?
No, I don't
But my brother does. He plays every day
I go online and shop for music
And do you text your friends every day?
Of course, I chat to them all the time
And how many hours a night do you sleep?
About six hours a night
My parents say it's not enough
Do you exercise?
Yes, I go to the gym for one hour on Saturday mornings
And then I have coffee in the cafe
Well, thank you Isabella
